newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-AMAVISCA OPERATION MAY LEAVE REAL SHORT OF STRIKERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMAVISCA OPERATION MAY LEAVE REAL SHORT OF STRIKERS.

text.p: Real Madrid will be without forward Jose Amavisca for between two and three months after club doctors decided to operate on the Spanish international's left knee.
Amavisca, who formed part of Spain's Euro 96 squad despite missing most of last season through injury, aggravated the knee warming up before Sunday's game with Hercules.
Real may be left short of front-line strikers after selling former top scorer Ivan Zamorano to Inter Milan and Alfonso Perez to Betis.
